Cumulative Position Counts

Source: R/data.R
cumulative_position_counts.Rd

Cumulative Position Counts

Usage

cumulative_position_counts

Format

dataframe with one row for each combination of song and normalized setlist position in the Fugazi Live Series data.

position

Normalized position of the song within the show's setlist, from 0 (first song) to 1 (last song)

title

Name of the song

release_title

Name of the corresponding discographical release

count

The cumulative count of the number of times the song had been performed up to and including this position.

Source

https://www.dischord.com/fugazi_live_series

Provenance

Derived-cleaned. Produced by Repeatr_1.

Examples

cumulative_position_counts
#> # A tibble: 8,708 × 4
#>    position title                release_title       count
#>       <dbl> <chr>                <chr>               <int>
#>  1        0 23 beats off         in on the killtaker     1
#>  2        0 and the same         margin walker          11
#>  3        0 argument             the argument            1
#>  4        0 arpeggiator          end hits                7
#>  5        0 back to base         red medicine            3
#>  6        0 bad mouth            fugazi                  6
#>  7        0 bed for the scraping red medicine            7
#>  8        0 birthday pony        red medicine           36
#>  9        0 blueprint            repeater               31
#> 10        0 break                end hits               62
#> # ℹ 8,698 more rows
